authorId.description: Structured slug identifying who maintains/distributes this item. Effective id is authorId.type.id. Independent of the freeform author credit.

version.description: Semver content version of this item build.

minAppVersion.description: Optional semver floor of the Spiral app that can load this item.

author.description: Freeform credit for the contribution's creator.

description.description: Short summary for lists/cards; keep longer notes in the pack README.

sounds.description: The pack's sound library: sound id to .wav path relative to the item root. Ids are kebab-case and unique within the pack.

cues.description: Author-chosen assignment of cues to sound ids from `sounds`. Activating the pack applies it. One sound may serve several cues; cues the app does not know are ignored.
